A warm place to pause

Your everyday cafe, with a little extra comfort.

Welcome to Hanuman Coffee Cafe. Whether you are catching up with friends, spending time with family, taking a study break or simply craving your favourite drink, HCC brings people together over good flavours and relaxed moments.

Choose the comfort of our AC dining or the easy-going Non-AC experience, then explore a menu made for coffee lovers, shake fans and snack-time cravings.
